title: Azure GPT-4.1 joins the text API
summary:
GPT-4.1 landed on the text API while nine more community-built things appeared in the project garden.

GPT-4.1 is now available through the openai-large route on text.pollinations.ai, adding another capable option behind the same simple text endpoint.

The community project list now includes Generator AI Image, MalaysiaPrompt, Strain Navigator, B&W SVG Generator, DreamBig, NetSim, the Raftar.xyz Discord bot, Smpldev, and an AI/Teens talk. Image tools, playgrounds, bots, network simulators: apparently the API has been wandering around.
